summary: A filterable, pre-built directory of ~1.56 million US mental health and behavioral health practitioners extracted from the CMS NPPES bulk data file — covering mental health counselors (395K+), clinical social workers (390K+), addiction counselors (144K+), marriage and family therapists (131K+), psychiatrists (94K+), and psychologists (73K+). The source is a free, no-auth-required monthly CSV download from download.cms.gov containing NPI number, provider name, address, phone, taxonomy codes, and entity type. Target buyers are EHR/practice management software companies, telehealth platforms recruiting therapists, insurance credentialing firms, and B2B marketers selling to mental health practices — all of whom currently pay $200–$500 for mere thousands of records from data vendors while this product delivers the complete national dataset at a flat price.

audience.who: Three distinct buyer segments: (1) SaaS companies targeting mental health practices (SimplePractice, TherapyNotes, TheraNest, Alma, Headway) that need verified provider lists for product marketing and therapist recruitment outreach; (2) telehealth platforms (BetterHelp, Talkspace, Brightside) that must identify and recruit licensed therapists state-by-state for network expansion — Talkspace alone was acquired for $835M in 2026, signaling aggressive network-building; (3) B2B data buyers such as insurance credentialing departments, continuing education vendors, and billing companies who currently spend $200+ on partial lists of 1,000–4,000 records from vendors like BizProspex and InfoCleanse.

data_wanted: CMS NPPES Full Replacement Monthly Data Dissemination File (Version 2, updated April 13, 2026 — 1,073 MB ZIP). Fields include: NPI Number, Entity Type Code (individual vs. organization), Provider Last/First/Middle Name, Provider Organization Name, Provider Other Organization Name, Provider First Line Business Mailing Address, Provider Second Line Business Mailing Address, Provider Business Mailing Address City Name, Provider Business Mailing Address State Name, Provider Business Mailing Address Postal Code, Provider Business Phone Number, Provider Business Fax Number, Provider First Line Business Practice Location Address, Provider Business Practice Location Address City/State/Zip, Healthcare Provider Taxonomy Code (up to 15 taxonomy slots per provider), Is Solo Practitioner, NPI Deactivation Reason Code, NPI Deactivation Date. Filter rows where any taxonomy code begins with 101Y (mental health counselor), 1041 (clinical social worker), 103T (psychologist), 106H (marriage and family therapist), 2084 (psychiatrist), or 101YA (addiction counselor) to extract the mental health subset. Direct download URL: https://download.cms.gov/nppes/NPI_Files.html — NO authentication required, publicly accessible under FOIA, free.

willingness_to_pay.signal: Multiple commercial data vendors (BizProspex, InfoCleanse, eSalesData, Provyx, MedicoLeads, LakeB2B) are selling mental health provider lists derived from or validated against NPPES at $200–$500 for 1,000–4,000 records. InfoCleanse advertises 1.25M+ therapist contacts. Provyx sells custom-quoted NPI-sourced lists. Buyers include SaaS companies, telehealth platforms actively recruiting therapists, and insurance credentialing teams — all with clear budget for provider data. A $49–$79 flat-fee complete national dataset would dominate on price vs. any competitor, while buyers see immediate ROI: one cold-email signup to SimplePractice ($49/mo) or Alma ($125/mo) pays back the list price in under a month.

first_sale_path.angle: Title: 'Complete US Mental Health Provider Directory — 1.4M+ Licensed Therapists, LCSWs, Counselors & Psychiatrists (NPI Data, May 2026)'. Key selling points: (1) Full national coverage — every licensed MH provider in the US with active NPI; (2) Filtered by 15+ mental health taxonomy codes so buyer gets only relevant records; (3) Fields: NPI, provider name, practice address, city/state/zip, phone, taxonomy code, entity type — ready for CRM import; (4) Sourced from CMS NPPES (same source credentialing companies use); (5) One-time download, no subscription. Price: $69 for full dataset, $49 for single-state slice. Positioning: 'Data vendors charge $200 for 1,000 leads. You get 1.4 million.'

ceo_decision.notes: Score 9. 1.4M+ licensed MH providers from CMS NPPES — no auth, FOIA-public. Competitors charge 00 for 1K records; we ship 1.4M for $69. High-conviction B2B market (EHR/telehealth SaaS). Added P7 to backlog.
